only) -- 403s for an LO (E16), same as every other admin-scoped route.

ApplicationRow.title: ApplicationRow
ApplicationRow.description:
One row of `GET /applications` (spec.md "Row"). Shared with CQ-026
(E9) -- keep this shape stable; CQ-026 imports it directly rather than
redefining it.

ApplicationStatus.title: ApplicationStatus
ApplicationStatus.description:
Mirrors the application status machine in `system-design.md`,
including the terminal `withdrawn`/`closed` states set by the LO.

ApplicationSummaryResponse.title: ApplicationSummaryResponse
ApplicationSummaryResponse.description:
`GET /applications/{id}/summary` (spec.md). Also the response shape
for `PATCH /applications/{id}/status` (plan.md decision #9) so the LO
console header/status pill refresh from one response.

ConfigSnapshot.title: ConfigSnapshot
ConfigSnapshot.description:
Pricing configuration, snapshotted per-quote so old quotes never change
when defaults change later (`scenarios.config_snapshot` stores one of
these as JSON per CQ-007).

ConsentSummary.title: ConsentSummary
ConsentSummary.description: E11: latest hard-pull consent request (CQ-033 fills the decision).

DSCRBucket.title: DSCRBucket
DSCRBucket.description: DSCR classification bucket. Boundaries are inclusive on the lower edge.

FieldSource.title: FieldSource
FieldSource.description: Drives the source badge + "revert to source" UI on `field_values`.

FieldValueOverrideRequest.title: FieldValueOverrideRequest
FieldValueOverrideRequest.description:
Every overridable pricing field (spec.md's fixed 5-key list) is a
currency or rate `Decimal`.

FlagSeverity.title: FlagSeverity
FlagSeverity.description:
Decision: `blocking` halts pipeline progression (Verifying ->
NeedsAttention) and blocks Send; `warning` is a visible tab count only;
`info` is reserved for auto-fix outcomes and never becomes a `flags`
row.

LoOption.title: LoOption
LoOption.description:
One entry of `GET /applications/los` -- the frontend's "LO" `Select`
for a Manager/Admin (spec.md "Frontend"). Nothing else in the backend
exposes a role=lo user list yet, so this item owns it (small, scoped
necessity -- plan.md).

Occupancy.title: Occupancy
Occupancy.description: Per override O2: Primary, LTR or STR only — no `second_home`.

PartyCreate.title: PartyCreate
PartyCreate.description: Adds the co-borrower (the only party the LO can add).

PortalReportResponse.title: PortalReportResponse
PortalReportResponse.description:
`ReportViewModel` plus the two fields only a live request can answer:
`borrower_action` (from `QuotePackageVersion.borrower_action`, `None`
until CQ-024) and `newest_report_token` (set only when this version is
superseded, per spec.md's "SupersededBanner ... a link to the newest
version").

PortalStage.title: PortalStage
PortalStage.description:
Borrower-facing stage (spec.md's mapping table), plus `draft` for an
open `application_drafts` row (CQ-032a) that has no `Application` yet.

PropertyPatch.title: PropertyPatch
PropertyPatch.description: Every key optional; `address` and `tbd=true` are mutually exclusive.

ReportMatch.description:
CQ-023's match cards (data-field-catalog §11). Every money/rate field
is a decimal string, same convention as every other `ReportViewModel`
field (module docstring) -- `packages/ui/src/report/MatchCard.tsx` never
does arithmetic on these. Investment-only fields (`rent_estimate`,
`rent_label`, `monthly_cashflow`, `cap_rate_pct`, `year1_tax_savings`)
are `None` for primary matches (spec.md: "Primary matches omit rent,
cashflow, cap rate and tax savings").
ReportMatch.title: ReportMatch

ReportStrategy.description:
Lowercase mirror of `pricing.engine.types.StrategyType`, per spec.md's
binding `strategy`: `primary` | `ltr` | `str` (the engine's own enum is
uppercase `PRIMARY`/`LTR`/`STR` -- this is a presentation-layer rename,
not a new business concept).
ReportStrategy.title: ReportStrategy

ScenarioCreateRequest.title: ScenarioCreateRequest
ScenarioCreateRequest.description:
The LO-owned pricing inputs (system-design's "only inputs the LO
owns" table) minus note rate, which is chosen per-quote, not at
scenario-creation time. FICO, tax, insurance, HOA and rent/STR are
enrichment-owned and read from `field_values` server-side.

StatusPatchRequest.title: StatusPatchRequest
StatusPatchRequest.description:
spec.md: "accepts only Withdrawn or Closed ... any other value
returns 422" -- the `Literal` does that natively via Pydantic/FastAPI
request validation, no extra code needed (plan.md decision #8).

StrategyType.title: StrategyType
StrategyType.description:
The engine's single occupancy/strategy field.

Mapping from `applications.occupancy` + `applications.strategy` (CQ-007)
onto this enum is CQ-013's job, not this item's.

ReportViewModel.description: The one contract. See module docstring.
ReportViewModel.title: ReportViewModel
